rationale: The two solutions are nearly identical: the same NUMBERS map, the same loop and the same blank-line handling. A builds the opening line once and reuses it, but writes the final line with awkward string concatenation and an inline plural expression. B uses well-named variables (bottle, count_word) and consistent f-strings, but repeats the opening f-string and also inlines the plural logic for the last line. Neither pulls out a pluralization helper. The small advantages cancel out.
